component.name: Proto KDE
component.summary: An image-based openSUSE Tumbleweed system with atomic updates

description.p: Proto KDE is an image-based Linux operating system built from openSUSE Tumbleweed and the KDE Plasma desktop.

ul.li: Versioned system deployments with atomic system updates
Delta updates using systemd-sysupdate and desync
Btrfs-backed mutable system and user state
